# LeaseRunner

> > LeaseRunner provides state-specific residential lease agreements, landlord-tenant law guides, and rental compliance resources for property managers across the United States.

LeaseRunner offers customizable lease templates with e-signature capabilities for cities and states, alongside comprehensive legal guides covering security deposits, eviction processes, tenant screening, squatter rights, and lease termination laws. The platform serves landlords and property managers navigating rental regulations across all 50 states.
